title: KPI consolidation, owner mapping, and launch sanity walkthrough
body:
Purpose and context:
- Quick working doc to: (1) consolidate overlapping KPIs across product/ops/eng ahead of Q4 roadmap freeze, (2) map clear owners for every launch signal, and (3) provide a lightweight sanity checklist teams can run in last-72-hours before traffic ramp.
- Why now: multiple teams maintain separate metric lists (latency, cost-per-token, adoption, false-positive alerts) with inconsistent owners. This causes last-minute handoffs and missed signals on launch day.

Scope:
- Focus: public-facing releases (hosted API + Dedicated tweaks) and big config rollouts (batching/quantization defaults). Not covering infra SRE low-level alerts (those live in SRE runbook).
- Output expected: single canonical KPI catalog (spreadsheet -> linked in artifacts), owner roster, launch readiness checklist, and lightweight tracker for milestone owners to sign off.

High-level approach (working steps):
1) Inventory: pull existing KPI sheets (product-ops, hosted-api, dedicated) and tag duplicates. Note: Evan has a raw merge export under the Confluence link above.
2) De-dup & canonicalize: for each metric, choose one canonical name, definition, measurement query, and SLA/target.
3) Owner mapping: assign a single accountable owner + a secondary contact for each metric. Document on the catalog row (owner Slack handle + pager if applicable).
4) Roadmap tie: link metrics to roadmap milestones (milestone id, date, owner). We add a 72-hour pre-launch gate for each milestone.
5) Launch sanity checklist: create a short preflight checklist that owners run T-72, T-24, T-0.

Inventory notes (quick):
- Duplicate metrics found:
  - "API p95 latency" appears as: hosted-api_p95, infra_latency_p95, perf_p95_hosted. Pick canonical: api.p95_ms (measures server-side latency excluding network ingress path). Query: prometheus example (sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=api})).
  - "Cost per 1k tokens" present in billing and product sheets; canonical: cost.per_1k_tokens_usd (rolling 30d average).
  - "Embedding accuracy (semantic)" exists in research and product. Canonical: eval.embedding.sim50 (dataset: internal-semantics-v1). Owner: research but product owns rollout decision.

Canonical KPI stub (examples):
- api.p95_ms | definition: 95th percentile server-side request latency for text-gen, 30d rolling | owner: @evan | target: < 600ms (default hosted) | linked: PRODOPS-482
- cost.per_1k_tokens_usd | definition: USD per 1k tokens processed (net of caching credits), 30d | owner: @sofia | target: <= $0.18 | linked: billing/cost-model sheet
- kvcache.hit_rate | definition: prefix cache hit rate for common prompts, 7d | owner: @liam | target: >= 0.55 | note: impacts p95 and cost
- embedding.stability.score | definition: regression delta vs baseline on eval kit, per-deploy | owner: @priya | target: delta <= 0.015 (abs)

Owner mapping rules (proposed):
- One accountable owner (R) per metric. Owner must be an active oncall or product lead for the feature area.
- One secondary owner (S) who monitors dashboards and can act if R is unavailable.
- For cross-cutting metrics (cost, latency), product-ops owns the canonical but individual milestone owners must sign off pre-launch.

Roadmap tracker (compact working table, owners to maintain):
- Milestone: hosted-api/streaming-v2 GA | planned date: 2025-11-15 | milestone owner: Priya Nair | linked KPIs: api.p95_ms, cost.per_1k_tokens_usd, streaming.error_rate | signoff owners: @prod-ops, @serving-runtime | status: at-risk (batching regression suspected)
- Milestone: dedicated/quant-profile-v3 | planned date: 2025-12-01 | owner: Liam O'Connor | KPIs: quant.inference_throughput, cost.per_1k_tokens_usd | status: on-track
- Milestone: optimize/kvcache-auto-config rollout | planned date: 2025-11-20 | owner: Evan Lee | KPIs: kvcache.hit_rate, api.p95_ms | status: needs-qa (A/B tests incomplete)

Launch sanity checklist (3 gates: T-72, T-24, T-0). Each item annotated with who must check and how to sign off (Slack reaction / doc comment).
- T-72 (product + infra):
  - dashboard exists with canonical KPIs and owner listed (owner: milestone owner)
  - smoke queries for each KPI validated on staging (owner: metric owner)
  - capacity reservation for expected peak (owner: infra capacity)
  - rollback plan documented and tested on canary (owner: release-eng)
  - known outstanding issues logged with impact assessment (owner: product-ops)
- T-24 (oncall + product):
  - runbook populated with throttles & rate-limits, emergency contacts (owner: SRE)
  - alert thresholds tested (owner: observability)
  - cost burn estimate for first 48 hours approved (owner: finance liaison)
  - customer comms draft ready if opt-in beta (owner: CS lead)
- T-0 (go/no-go):
  - all T-24 items green or mitigated (gatekeeper: product-ops lead)
  - canary traffic observed for 1 hour with no critical regressions (owner: release-eng)
  - fallback routing & model variant mapping verified (owner: serving-runtime)
  - owner & secondary acknowledge via Slack reaction on signoff message (owner: milestone owner)

Quick checklist for metric owners (operations hygiene):
- Ensure metric definition includes: query, window, denominator (if any), SLA target, owner contact, and linked alert ID.
- Add a one-line "how to triage" note (2–3 steps) for each metric.
- If metric crosses threshold during T-72/T-24, mark as "prelaunch mitigation" and publish steps.

Open risks & mitigations (notes):
- Risk: Ownership ambiguity for composite metrics (example: cost-per-token depends on caching + infra pricing).
  - Mitigation: product-ops holds canonical; finance/infra provide pricing inputs; milestone owner signs off.
- Risk: Too many KPIs -> signal noise.
  - Mitigation: prune to top-5 per milestone; everything else moves to "observability" backlog with owners.
- Risk: Late query drift (dashboards run on slightly different queries).
  - Mitigation: single query bundle checked into repo (see linked GH PR) and referenced by dashboards.

Decision log (recent):
- 2025-10-22: Chose cost.per_1k_tokens_usd as canonical vs cost.token-bucket. Rationale: easier to communicate to finance and maps to billing. Owner: Sofia.
- 2025-10-28: Require 72-hour gate for all public releases. Rationale: reduce last-minute firefighting.

Next steps (immediate owners & asks):
- Evan: finish the merged KPI export and drop CSV into the Confluence catalog by 2025-11-05. (Blockers: access to two private sheets)
- Priya: prepare T-72 checklist template per milestone and add to release templates by 2025-11-07.
- Liam: confirm secondary owners for infra metrics and add pager contact points by 2025-11-04.
- Sofia (me): create the canonical spreadsheet row format and push a PR updating dashboards to reference canonical queries (PR link above).

Notes to self / messy brainstorm (leave in doc):
- Could we auto-generate T-72 reminders via a lightweight bot that posts instructions to milestone channel? Low-effort MVP: Slack reminder + link to checklist doc.
- Consider a "pruning workshop" for Q1 to reduce KPI count across product areas. Invite: product leads, eng leads, finance.

Appendix: quick metric snapshot (rolling 7d as of 2025-10-31)
- api.p95_ms: 420ms
- api.error_rate (5xx): 0.12%
- cost.per_1k_tokens_usd: $0.20 (note: target $0.18)
- kvcache.hit_rate: 0.48 (below target 0.55)
- embedding.stability.score: 0.008 delta (within target)

Comments / how to sign off on this doc:
- Add comments in-place or leave a Slack thread in #prodops-launches with the doc link. When owners have confirmed their rows in the canonical spreadsheet, update the milestone status in the tracker and change this doc status to "final".

-- end of working doc --
